stories.title: Callers told a grieving north Wales family their dead relative had left £300,000 in crypto
stories.summary: North Wales Police have warned that fraudsters are targeting families after a death by claiming their relative left behind a cryptocurrency fortune. The force’s cyber crime unit said the family of a north Wales resident who had died were contacted by criminals claiming their relative had invested in cryptocurrency before they died. stories.title: Theatr Clwyd takes on 20,000 bees as part of environmental plans
stories.summary: Two beehives holding around 20,000 bees have been installed on the roof of Theatr Clwyd in Mold, the first time bees have been kept at the theatre. stories.title: Flintshire clubs told to check pitch hardness before matches go ahead
stories.summary: Football matches and training sessions in Flintshire should not go ahead on pitches left rock-hard by the dry weather, under interim guidance issued by the Football Association of Wales.
